name: Export CSV
description: Turns a table on the page into a CSV that Excel opens directly: it grabs the table, generates the file and downloads it, all locally

zh.name: 导出 CSV
zh.description: 把页面上的表格导成 Excel 能直接打开的 CSV：抓表、生成、下载，都在本地

agentHints: This app already has the "Export CSV" component installed (tenon.official.csv-export). It grabs <table> elements from the page itself and asks the server side to build the CSV — **do not write your own export logic**. To export something that is not on the page, render that data into a <table data-tenon-export="filename"> and it will pick it up.
